name: InventoryContainer
src_typeComment: Fixed-capacity, slot-based inventory with automatic stacking. AddItem/RemoveItem work by ItemDefinition reference at runtime; GetSaveData()/LoadSaveData() bridge to SaveSystem the same way CurrencyWallet does — items are saved by their string Id (from GameDataAsset), resolved back via an ItemRegistry on load.

src_serialized.name: capacity
src_serialized.tooltip: Number of inventory slots. A stackable item (maxStackSize > 1) can hold more than one slot's worth once a single slot caps out.

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<int, ItemDefinition> OnSlotChanged = new UnityEvent<int, ItemDefinition>()
src_members.name: UnityEvent
src_members.comment: slot index, item currently there (null if the slot just emptied) — a UI grid can rebuild just the one changed cell instead of the whole inventory.

src_members.sig: public int AddItem(ItemDefinition item, int quantity = 1)
src_members.name: AddItem
src_members.comment: Returns how many were actually added (may be less than requested if the inventory is full) — always check the return value rather than assuming the full amount fit.

src_members.sig: public bool HasItem(ItemDefinition item, int quantity = 1) => GetQuantity(item) >= quantity
src_members.name: HasItem

src_members.sig: public bool RemoveItem(ItemDefinition item, int quantity = 1)
src_members.name: RemoveItem
src_members.comment: Removes from the LAST matching slots first (fills-from-front, drains-from-back) so a UI showing slots left-to-right doesn't visually jump items into earlier slots on every removal. Returns false (leaving the inventory untouched) if there isn't enough of the item to remove.

src_members.sig: public void LoadSaveData(List<SaveEntry> data, ItemRegistry registry)
src_members.name: LoadSaveData
src_members.comment: `registry` resolves each saved itemId back to its ItemDefinition asset. Clears the inventory first so a load doesn't merge on top of whatever the inventory already held (e.g. its Inspector-authored starting state).
